rare.why: DWDS: verkommen = go to ruin, decay; run-down (adjective)
DWDS: überkommen = overcome (a feeling comes over you); traditional (adjective)

forms.ex: Woher kommen Sie?
forms.exEn: Where do you come from?

forms.en: vom Weg abkommen: stray from the path
forms.clue: to stray (from the path, the topic)
forms.ex: Wir sind vom Thema abgekommen.
forms.exEn: We've got off the topic.
forms.why: ab = off, away.

forms.en: arrive; es kommt darauf an: it depends
forms.clue: to arrive; to depend (es kommt darauf an)
forms.ex: Der Zug kommt um acht an.
forms.exEn: The train arrives at eight.
forms.why: an = at: come to the place.

forms.en: come up, arise; für etwas aufkommen: pay for
forms.clue: to arise (doubts, wind); to pay for (für etwas)
forms.ex: Die Versicherung kommt für den Schaden auf.
forms.exEn: The insurance pays for the damage.
forms.why: auf = up: something comes up.

forms.en: get by (with money); get on (with someone)
forms.clue: to get by (on money); to get on (with)
forms.ex: Wir kommen gut miteinander aus.
forms.exEn: We get on well with each other.
forms.why: aus = out, to the end: you come out at the end with enough.

forms.clue: to come along
forms.ex: Kommst du mit?
forms.exEn: Are you coming along?
forms.why: mit = along.

forms.en: come later, follow; comply with (einer Bitte nachkommen)
forms.clue: to follow (later), to join later
forms.ex: Ich komme später nach.
forms.exEn: I will follow later.
forms.why: nach = after.

forms.clue: to happen, to occur; to seem
forms.ex: So etwas kommt vor.
forms.exEn: These things happen.
forms.why: vor = in front: something comes forward into view. Das kommt mir komisch vor = that seems odd to me.

forms.clue: to die (in an accident, a disaster)
forms.ex: Bei dem Unfall kam niemand um.
forms.exEn: No one died in the accident.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: um here does not mean around.

forms.clue: to get through (a crowd, an exam)
forms.ex: Hier ist so viel Verkehr, wir kommen nicht durch.
forms.exEn: There is so much traffic here, we can't get through.
forms.why: durch = through to the other side.

forms.clue: to find a place to stay
forms.ex: Wir kommen bei Freunden unter.
forms.exEn: We are staying with friends.
forms.why: unter = under: get under a roof.

forms.clue: to get, to receive
forms.ex: Ich bekomme morgen mein Ergebnis.
forms.exEn: I get my result tomorrow.
forms.why: Learn it as a word. It does not mean "become" (that is werden). A be- verb with an object: hat bekommen.

forms.clue: to escape (from)
forms.ex: Der Dieb ist durch das Fenster entkommen.
forms.exEn: The thief escaped through the window.
forms.why: ent = away from.

forms.clue: the arrival
forms.ex: Die Ankunft des Zuges verzögert sich um zehn Minuten.
forms.exEn: The train's arrival is delayed by ten minutes.
forms.note: -kunft is an old stem of kommen: die Ankunft, die Auskunft, die Zukunft. Nouns in -kunft are always die.

forms.clue: to come up to (auf jemanden); to lie ahead (auf uns)
forms.ex: Auf uns kommt viel Arbeit zu.
forms.exEn: A lot of work lies ahead of us.
forms.why: zu = toward: something comes toward you, so it lies ahead.

forms.clue: the future
forms.ex: In Zukunft möchte ich im Ausland arbeiten.
forms.exEn: In future I'd like to work abroad.
forms.note: What comes towards us: die Zukunft.

forms.clue: a deposit (of oil, gas); the occurrence
forms.ex: In der Region gibt es große Vorkommen an Gas.
forms.exEn: The region has large gas deposits.
forms.note: The infinitive as a noun: always das.

forms.en: drop by, come by; get past
forms.clue: to drop by (for a visit)
forms.ex: Kannst du morgen kurz vorbeikommen?
forms.exEn: Can you drop by tomorrow?
forms.why: vorbei = past, by: you come by someone's place.

forms.clue: the income (what you earn)
forms.ex: Sie hat ein gutes Einkommen.
forms.exEn: She has a good income.
forms.why: The money that comes in: the infinitive as a noun, so das.

forms.en: information (given when you ask); information desk
forms.clue: the information (you ask for); info desk
forms.ex: Fragen Sie bitte an der Auskunft.
forms.exEn: Please ask at the information desk.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: -kunft is an old noun of kommen; it is not a noun of auskommen (get by).

forms.clue: to come here; to come from (origin)
forms.ex: Wo kommst du eigentlich her?
forms.exEn: Where are you actually from?
forms.why: her = here, toward the speaker; from a source.

forms.clue: the origin, someone's background
forms.ex: Seine Herkunft spielt bei uns keine Rolle.
forms.exEn: His background doesn't matter to us.
forms.why: Where you come from (herkommen). Nouns in -kunft are die.

forms.clue: the accommodation (a place to stay)
forms.ex: Wir suchen noch eine Unterkunft für drei Nächte.
forms.exEn: We're still looking for accommodation for three nights.

forms.clue: the agreement (between countries)
forms.ex: Die beiden Länder haben ein neues Abkommen unterzeichnet.
forms.exEn: The two countries have signed a new agreement.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: it does not come from vom Weg abkommen (stray).

forms.clue: the descendant
forms.ex: Er ist ein Nachkomme einer alten Familie.
forms.exEn: He is a descendant of an old family.
forms.why: Those who come after (nachkommen) you.
forms.note: der Nachkomme: a person, so der, not die like most -e nouns (des Nachkommen).

forms.clue: to come back
forms.ex: Wann kommst du aus dem Urlaub zurück?
forms.exEn: When are you coming back from holiday?
forms.why: zurück = back.

forms.en: come out; be released (a film, a book); turn out
forms.clue: to come out (of a room; a new film)
forms.ex: Der neue Film kommt nächste Woche heraus.
forms.exEn: The new film comes out next week.
forms.why: heraus = out: you come out of a room; a film comes out to the public.

forms.clue: to make progress, to get further
forms.ex: Mit dieser Methode kommen wir nicht weiter.
forms.exEn: We won't get any further with this method.
forms.why: weiter = on, further: you come further along.

forms.clue: to meet, to gather (people)
forms.ex: Die ganze Familie kommt an Weihnachten zusammen.
forms.exEn: The whole family gets together at Christmas.
forms.why: zusammen = together.

forms.clue: to meet (someone) halfway; to come the other way
forms.ex: Der Vermieter ist uns beim Preis entgegengekommen.
forms.exEn: The landlord met us halfway on the price.
forms.why: entgegen = toward: you come toward someone, also in a deal.

forms.clue: future (as in future plans)
forms.ex: Das ist mein zukünftiger Chef.
forms.exEn: That is my future boss.
forms.note: The u of -kunft becomes ü before -ig.
